name: B10-0144/2025 (The Left) – White paper on the future of European defence
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text:
This is a resolution from the Left group in the European Parliament. It does not change any law. It sets out what the group wants: the EU should stop building up its military, end its close alignment with NATO, and pull back from US foreign policy. It calls for diplomacy, arms control and spending on public services and climate instead of defence. It also asks for US nuclear weapons to be removed from EU soil.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a statement of demands, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, NATO, the US, and defence industries.
- **What happens next:** Parliament votes on it; other EU bodies are not bound.
